confirmation_rule: If batch1 suggests low success, rerun all six task-model combinations with fresh UUIDs as a separately preregistered confirmation batch. Never overwrite or silently retry the first batch.
validity_rule: Environment errors, identity discrepancies, ambiguous diagrams, and unsupported equivalent valid actions cannot be evidence of model incapability. Report operational scores including environment errors separately and require at least four valid episodes per model for confirmation.
causal_audit: Inspect every failure against diagrams, public instructions and documented interfaces. Replay claimed valid-but-rejected actions as targeted environment diagnostics; keep rejected/rollback evidence. Do not change an answer, prompt, threshold or action interface based on task/model failure and still pool scores.
adaptation_rule: If these tasks score high or failures are confounded, qualify new multi-layer or spatial tasks with independent references and negative controls before freezing next batch. Preserve every candidate and every outcome. This is an adaptive development challenge set, not an unbiased held-out model ranking.
statistics_note: Small repeated sample, descriptive low-score evidence only; report counts and intervals, not guaranteed model ceiling.
prepaid_fixes: Full-paper viewport for supported rectangles and translations, preserving world coordinate ticks.
Generic task scope precedence and public 600-frame motion-bound disclosure; same new policy for every evaluated model/task.
Explicit repeat IDs and correct precrease suite metadata.
